scenes.zh:
山坡上，阿禾守着三只羊。
四周静悄悄的，他觉得有点无聊。
scenes.en:
Ahe looked after three sheep on a hillside.
It was so quiet that he felt bored.

scenes.zh:
阿禾朝村里喊：“狼来了！”
村民们急忙跑上山，却只看见他在笑。
scenes.en:
Ahe called toward the village, “Wolf!”
The villagers ran up the hill and found Ahe laughing.

scenes.zh:
过了几天，阿禾又喊：“狼来了！”
两位村民赶来一看，还是没有狼。
scenes.en:
A few days later, Ahe shouted “Wolf!” again.
Two villagers came to look. There was still no wolf.

scenes.zh:
傍晚，一只狼真的从松树后走了出来。
阿禾急得大喊：“狼来了！”
scenes.en:
One evening, a real wolf stepped out from behind the pine tree.
Ahe cried, “Wolf!”

scenes.zh:
这一次，山路上一个人也没有。
三只羊吓得跑散了，阿禾只好自己去找。
scenes.en:
This time, no one came up the path.
The sheep ran off, so Ahe had to find them on his own.

scenes.zh:
阿禾找回了羊，低着头回到村里。
他说：“对不起，前两次我不该骗大家。”
scenes.en:
Ahe found his sheep and went back to the village with his head down.
“I’m sorry I tricked you twice,” he said.
